results.title: Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ta faro taron yanayi na COP31 a Turkiya
results.content: An faro babban taron yanayi na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya wato COP31 yau Litinin a birnin Antalya na Turkiya, taron da zai tattaro shugabanni da wakilcin kusan dukkanin ƙasashen duniya da nufin haɗa hannu don tunƙarar matsalar ta ɗumama ko kuma sauyin yanayi.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Gwamnatin Najeriya ta musanta zargin ciyo bashin naira tiriliyan 120 a shekaru 3
results.content: Fadar gwamnatin Najeriya ta yi watsi da bayanan da ke nuna cewar shugaba Bola Ahmed Tinubu, ya karɓi bashin da yawansa ya kai Naira Triliyan 120 a cikin shekaru Uku kaɗai, duk da cewa ya janye biyan tallafin man fetur.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: EU ta aike da wakilci a tattaunawar Rasha da Ukraine bisa shiga tsakanin Amurka
results.content: Ministan harkokin wajen Faransa Jean-Noel Barrot, ya ce Ƙungiyar Tarayyar Turai, za ta aike da wakilcinta zuwa tattaunawar da za a sake yi, tsakanin Rasha da Ukraine da wanda Amurka ke shiga tsakani, a ƙoƙarinta na kawo ƙarshen yaƙi tsakanin ƙasashen 2 maƙwabtan juna.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: Ƴan farar hula a Nijar sun caccaki EU kan sukar yarjejeniyar ƙasar da Algeria
results.content: Gamayyar ƙungiyoyin fararen hula a yankin Arlit da ke Arewacin jamhuriyyar Nijar ya zargi ƙungiyar Tarayyar Turai da yin ƙatsalandan a lamurran suka shafi ƙasar, bayan da ƙungiyar ta EU ta buƙaci a yi ma ta ƙarin bayani dangane da yarjejeniyar soji da aka ƙulla tsakanin Algeria da Nijar.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Ghana ta gindaya sharuɗɗan miƙa shaidar lafiya gabanin shiga ƙasar
results.content: Hukumomin kiwon lafiya a Ghana sun ce daga ranar Alhamis 12 ga wannan wata na Nuwamba, zai zama tilas ga dukkanin matafiya da ke son shiga ƙasar su gabatar da cikakkun bayanai da suka shafi lafiyarsu, gabanin samun izinin sanya ƙafa a ƙasar ta yankin yammacin Afrika.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Ƴanbindiga sun ƙona mutum 12 ƴan gida ɗaya da rai a jihar Zamfara
results.content: Ƴan bindiga sun ƙona mutum 12 ƴan gida ɗaya da rai tare da garkuwa da sauran waɗanda suka rage a wani harin da suka kai ƙauyen Gidan Taba na karamar hukumar Maradun a jihar Zamfara.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Amurka ta ƙaddamar da runduna ta musamman da za ta riƙa tare jiragen Iran
results.content: Amurka ta ƙaddamar da runduna ta musamman da ta ɗora wa alhakin datse dukkanin hanyoyi na kan tudu da Iran ke amfani da su wajen samu, ko jigilar muhimman kayayyaki ciki har da makamai.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Ƴan cirani 21 sun mutu a gabar ruwan Senegal
results.content: A Senegal ana cigaba da aikin ceto don gano masu sauran numfashi bayan wani ƙwale-ƙwale ya kife da ƴan cirani a gabar ruwan Kebemer da ke arewa maso yammacin ƙasar.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: Ƙasashen Afrika na fuskantar barazanar yaɗuwar cutar Ebola
results.content: Shirin Lafiya Jari ce a wannan makon ya yi duba ne kan cutar Ebola da yanzu haka ke barazana ga duniya musamman ƙasashen nahiyar Afrika tun bayan ɓullarta a Jamhuriyyar Congo cikin watan Mayun shekarar nan. Kawo yanzu cutar ta Ebola nau’in Bundibugyo da ba a iya kai ga nasarar samar da magani ko kuma rigakafinta ba, ta kashe mutanen da yawansu ya haura dubu 5 cikin mutum fiye da dubu 10 da suka harbu a Congo, yayinda a ɓangare guda ta fantsama wasu ƙasashen Afrika.

results.title: Alhaji Sa’adu Gulma shugaban ƴan Arewa mazauna Kudancin Najeriya ƴan jam’iyyar APC
results.content: Yayin da ƴan siyasa suka fantsama gadan-gadan domin yaƙin neman zaɓe a Najeriya, kusan dukannin jam’iyyu na ci gaba da zawarcin ƴan asalin Arewacin ƙasar da ke zaune a yankin Kudanci saboda muhimmacin ƙuri’unsu. Abdoulkarim Ibrahim Shikal ya zanta da Alhaji Sa’adu Yusuf Ɗandare Gulma, shugaban ƴan Arewa mazauna jihohin Kudancin Najeriya mabiya jam’iyyar APC mai mulki, domin jin irin rawar da suke takawa a wannan tafiya.

results.title: Bamuji ɗaɗin irin rabuwar da aka yi tsakanin Ronaldo da Portugal ba - Ra'ayoyi
results.content: Shirin na duniyar wasanni a wannan lokaci yayi duba ne game da bankwana da tawagar Portugal da Ronaldo yayi. A cikin wani saƙon bidiyo da ya wallafa a shafinsa, lamarin da ke kawo ƙarshen shekaru fiye da 20 da ya shafe yana wakiltar ƙasar shi a matakin ƙwallon ƙafar duniya. Cikin saƙon na Ronaldo, ya ce bayan nutsuwa cikin tsananki ya fahimci cewa lokaci ya yi da zai kawo ƙarshen wakiltar ƙasar shi kodayake ya ce Portugal za ta ci gaba da kasancewa a zuciyar shi.

results.title: Michael Carrick ya sha alwashin ci gaba da jagorantar Man United
results.content: Mai horas da ƙungiyar ƙwallon ƙafa ta Manchester United Michael Carrick, ya ce baya da niyar barin aikinsa na horas da ƙungiyar.

results.title: Infantino ya taya Flamingos murnar lashe kofin duniya da suka yi a Morocco
results.content: Shugaban Hukumar Kwallon Ƙafa ta Duniya FIFA Gianni Infantino, ya taya tawagar mata ta Najeriya ƴan ƙasa da shekaru 17, murnar lashe kofin duniya a wannan mataki.

results.title: INEC za tayi zaman gaggawa kan takarar Atiku Abubukar a zaɓen 2027
results.content: Hukumar zaɓen Najeriya INEC, za ta yi zama na musamman don tattauna batun takarar Atiku Abubakar a zaɓen 2027.

results.title: Ɓaraka ta kunno kai a cikin ƙungiyar mayaƙan RSF ta Sudan
results.content: A Sudan ,ƙungiyar mayaƙan RSF na cigaba da rasa manyan jiga-jganta yayin da ake shirin shiga shekara ta huɗu a yakin da ta ke gwabzawa da dakarun gwamnatin Sudan karkashin jagorancin Abdel-fattah Alburhan.

results.title: Tsohon ministan tsaron Nijar Kalla Moutari ya cika watanni biyu a tsare
results.content: A jamhuriyar Nijar, tsohon ministan tsaron ƙasar Kalla Moutari ya cika watanni biyu a hannu jami’an tsaro Jandarma tu bayan kama shi ƴan ƙwanaki da yunkurin juyin mulkin da wasu sojoji suka so su yi karshen watan Augusta da ya wuce.

results.title: Tinubu ya bukaci ƴan Najeriya su tambayi Atiku yadda ya samu kuɗaden gina makaranta
results.content: Shugaba Bola Tinubu ya kalubalanci ƴan adawa masu neman kawo cikas ga tsarin gwamnatin Najeriya da suke dangata shi da wanda ya kasa tabuka wani abu a zo a gani a shugabancinsa.
